result.summary: Found 1 major issue: a restaurant card image appears to be in a loading or broken state.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card image in the 'Popular right now' section displays a loading spinner overlay, indicating the image has not finished loading or has failed to render properly.
issues.suggestion: Ensure images are fully loaded before rendering the card, or implement a proper placeholder/skeleton screen while images load. Also add error handling to display a fallback image if the load fails.
